topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing 19th harmonics reduces interference, improving power allocation efficiency. However, increased filter complexity may introduce nonlinear distortions, interacting with amplifier nonlinearities to degrade transponder performance. Optimized filter design and signal modulation schemes balance spectral efficiency and distortion tolerance.
reference_context: Satellite communications face challenges from nonlinear distortions and interference, affecting power efficiency and spectral usage.
